Title: ExifGlass 3 - UI Revamp for AI Prompt Inspection & Metadata Editing
Description:
- New beautiful app GUI
- New metadata table with search, sorting, group filters and quick filters
- New inspector panel with preview, exposure, camera, lens, date and location
- Edit, add and delete tags
- Remove GPS data, AI data, or all metadata
- Show AI prompts and generation settings
- Screen reader support
